svg.title: Growing a three-ring tile by two hexagons
svg.desc: The best elongated and compact scores observed, with exact placements, missing cells and the original 17-cell outlines of all four finalists.
svg.text: Growing a three-ring tile by two hexagons
Best finite layouts found among 59,968 distinct 19-hexagon shapes
The four finite shapes that kept all three rings
Orange marks the two added hexagons. All four tiles are shown at the same scale.
